slides.texte_overlay:
subtle signs your mind is
sharper than you realise

you enjoy your own thoughts

you can spend hours alone without getting bored. a mind that keeps itself company usually has plenty of interesting things going on inside it all the time.

you change your mind

when someone shows you good evidence, you update your view without a fight. being able to say i was wrong is one of the clearest signs of intelligence.

you keep seeking new ideas

your mind always wants something new to learn, and you feed it on purpose. it's a small change with a surprisingly big effect. try it for one week and notice the difference.
slides.texte_sophia:
you keep seeking new ideas

my mind always wants something new. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a planet or a painting, and even that small dose keeps a curious mind happy.

slides.texte_overlay:
you ask a lot of questions

you can't hear about something new without wondering how it works. constant questions are the quiet habit behind almost every brilliant mind. it honestly works.

you connect unrelated things

you link things that seem to have nothing in common: a song and a memory, a habit and a mood. spotting connections is a powerful kind of intelligence.
